weapons.name: Terra Blade
weapons.source: Crafted (True Excalibur + True Night's Edge + Broken Hero Swords)
weapons.why: Fires a fast green sword beam projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: The Eye of Cthulhu
weapons.source: Dropped by Mothron during a Solar Eclipse (occurs post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Post-Plantera Solar Eclipse Mothron drop with infinite spin.

weapons.name: Paladin's Hammer
weapons.source: Dropped by Paladins in the post-Plantera Dungeon
weapons.why: High-damage throwing hammer dropped by post-Plantera Dungeon Paladins.

weapons.name: Flower Pow
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Post-Plantera flail dropped by Plantera that releases petals.

weapons.name: Christmas Tree Sword
weapons.source: Dropped by Everscream (Frost Moon)
weapons.why: Fires ornament projectiles when swung.

weapons.name: Seedler
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Fires Seedler Nut projectiles that burst into thorn balls.

weapons.name: Keybrand
weapons.source: Dropped by Hardmode Dungeon armored bones
weapons.why: Deals bonus damage to enemies below half health.

weapons.name: North Pole
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon
weapons.why: Frost Moon spear that releases a homing snowflake and falling ice.

weapons.name: Psycho Knife
weapons.source: Dropped by Psychos (Solar Eclipse)
weapons.why: Grants stealth and increased damage while standing still.

weapons.name: The Horseman's Blade
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking (Pumpkin Moon)
weapons.why: Summons homing pumpkin projectiles when hitting enemies.

weapons.name: Kraken
weapons.source: 1/400 drop from post-Plantera Hardmode Dungeon enemies
weapons.why: Post-Plantera Dungeon drop and one of the strongest yoyos.

weapons.name: Vampire Knives
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Crimson Chest (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires a spread of knives that heal the player on hit.

weapons.name: Scourge of the Corruptor
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Corruption Chest (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires an Eater's Bite projectile that splits into homing worms.

weapons.name: Fetid Baghnakhs
weapons.source: Dropped by Crimson Mimics
weapons.why: Extremely fast, very short-range broadsword from Crimson Mimics.

weapons.name: Red's Throw
weapons.source: Any Hardmode boss's Expert/Master Treasure Bag (except Queen Slime), as part of Red's set
weapons.why: Expert-exclusive developer yoyo from Hardmode boss Treasure Bags.

weapons.name: Light Disc
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Hallowed Bars, Souls of Light, and Souls of Might
weapons.why: Bouncing disc requiring Souls of Might from the Destroyer.

weapons.name: Drippler Crippler
weapons.source: Dropped by Blood Eels (Hardmode Blood Moon)
weapons.why: Hardmode Blood Moon flail dropped by Blood Eels.

weapons.name: True Excalibur
weapons.source: Crafted (Excalibur + Broken Hero Sword)
weapons.why: Fires a projectile on swing; needs post-Plantera Broken Hero Sword.

weapons.name: Shadowflame Knife
weapons.source: Dropped by Goblin Warlocks during a Hardmode Goblin Army
weapons.why: Throws ricocheting knives that inflict the Shadowflame debuff.

armor.name: Turtle Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Turtle Shells and Chlorophyte Bars
armor.why: This is the safest conventional pre-Golem melee set because the research around Beetle timing is still a little contested.

armor.name: Chlorophyte Armor
armor.why: If you prefer a more generalist route, Chlorophyte still performs well through this entire phase.

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: It is still the easiest best-in-slot melee accessory to justify because it rolls several offensive benefits into one slot.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Post-Plantera enemies and events apply enough debuffs that this becomes even more comfortable than before.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: The broad stat bonus is valuable for any melee build that has already stabilized its core survival tools.

accessories.name: Steampunk or Hoverboard Wings
accessories.source: Obtained from strong post-Plantera mobility routes
accessories.why: Flight is still mandatory when your farming loop now includes the Hardmode Dungeon, events, and Temple approach.

accessories.name: Destroyer Emblem
accessories.source: Crafted from Avenger Emblem and Eye of the Golem.
accessories.why: +10% damage and +8% crit, stacking with your class emblem.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.source: Crafted from Tabi, Black Belt, and Climbing Claws (Tinkerer).
accessories.why: Dash, a dodge chance, and wall-climb in a single slot.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.why: The defense shred is still the most efficient weapon imbue you can carry into hard targets.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: It remains the universal baseline buff because every new event or Temple pull can hit hard.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Damage reduction continues to scale beautifully once you are tackling denser enemy packs and longer encounters.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.why: A direct damage increase helps speed up event waves and cut down awkward boss phases.

weapons.name: Eventide
weapons.source: Dropped by Empress of Light (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires homing star arrows, converting wooden arrows for free.

weapons.name: Stake Launcher
weapons.source: Dropped by Mourning Wood (Pumpkin Moon)
weapons.why: A repeater that fires high-damage Stakes as its ammunition.

weapons.name: Chain Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Santa-NK1 (Frost Moon)
weapons.why: Rapid-fire gun dropped by Santa-NK1 during the post-Plantera Frost Moon.

weapons.name: Sniper Rifle
weapons.source: Dropped by Skeleton Snipers in the post-Plantera Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: High single-shot damage gun dropped by Skeleton Snipers after Plantera.

weapons.name: Venus Magnum
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Fast-firing pistol dropped by Plantera.

weapons.name: Candy Corn Rifle
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking (Pumpkin Moon)
weapons.why: Fires candy corn projectiles and is dropped by Pumpking during the post-Plantera Pumpkin Moon.

weapons.name: Tactical Shotgun
weapons.source: Dropped by Tactical Skeletons in the post-Plantera Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: Upgraded shotgun dropped by Tactical Skeletons after Plantera is defeated.

weapons.name: Grenade Launcher
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Lobs arcing grenades that use rocket ammo and explode on impact.

weapons.name: Jack 'O Lantern Launcher
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires jack-o'-lantern projectiles using rocket ammo.

weapons.name: Nail Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Nailheads during a Solar Eclipse (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires Nails that stick into surfaces and enemies.

weapons.name: Proximity Mine Launcher
weapons.source: Purchased from the Cyborg, who moves in after Plantera is defeated
weapons.why: Fires mines that stick to surfaces and detonate when enemies come near.

weapons.name: Rocket Launcher
weapons.source: Dropped by Skeleton Commandos in the Hardmode Dungeon (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires rockets whose loaded ammo type sets the projectile's damage and blast behavior.

weapons.name: Snowman Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires homing rockets that track the nearest enemy.

weapons.name: Piranha Gun
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Jungle Chest (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Latches a piranha onto an enemy that chews continuously.

weapons.name: Chlorophyte Shotbow
weapons.source: Crafted from Chlorophyte Bars
weapons.why: Can fire up to four arrows at once when held.

weapons.name: Pulse Bow
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant after defeating all three mechanical bosses
weapons.why: Fires a piercing pulse arrow that bounces off blocks.

weapons.name: Beenade
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Bee; crafted with Bee Wax from Queen Bee
weapons.why: A Queen Bee consumable that releases homing bees on detonation.

weapons.name: Super Star Shooter
weapons.source: Crafted (Star Cannon + 12 Hallowed Bars)
weapons.why: Hallowed upgrade to the Star Cannon.

weapons.name: Flamethrower
weapons.source: Crafted (20 Iron Bars + Illegal Gun Parts + 20 Souls of Fright)
weapons.why: Sprays a continuous cone of fire fuelled by Gel.

armor.name: Shroomite Armor
armor.why: This is the consensus best ranger set in the phase because its helmet specialization and stealth utility are both real upgrades.

armor.name: Chlorophyte Armor
armor.why: It remains a respectable fallback if your glowing mushroom setup or bar conversion route is not ready.

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: It is still the cleanest premium ranger accessory because the crit and aim support both stay relevant.

accessories.name: Ranger Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: The direct damage bonus remains easy to slot into nearly every build in the phase.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: A broad stat increase is especially nice once your weapon choices are already very strong.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Debuff immunity is valuable in the post-Plantera farming loop where random hits can stack ugly statuses fast.

accessories.name: Destroyer Emblem
accessories.source: Crafted from Avenger Emblem and Eye of the Golem.
accessories.why: +10% damage and +8% crit, stacking with your class emblem.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.source: Crafted from Tabi, Black Belt, and Climbing Claws (Tinkerer).
accessories.why: Dash, a dodge chance, and wall-climb in a single slot.

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.why: It stays the best simple class buff for ranger, especially if your setup still leans on bows anywhere in the phase.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.why: Ammo savings matter more once rapid-fire endgame-adjacent weapons enter the picture.

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.why: This is free ranged value before every major encounter and stacks with the potion nicely.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Even ranger benefits from a sturdier baseline once events and Temple pulls get chaotic.

weapons.name: Wasp Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Fires several homing wasp projectiles per shot.

weapons.name: Leaf Blower
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Rapidly fires small leaf projectiles.

weapons.name: Bat Scepter
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking (Pumpkin Moon)
weapons.why: Fires a spread of homing bats at nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Blizzard Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Ice Queen (Frost Moon)
weapons.why: Calls down a barrage of ice shards from the sky over an area.

weapons.name: Magnet Sphere
weapons.source: Dropped by armored bones and Diabolists in the post-Plantera Dungeon
weapons.why: Launches a slow sphere that fires lightning bolts at nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Nettle Burst
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Projects an extending line of thorns that pierces through blocks.

weapons.name: Nightglow
weapons.source: Dropped by Empress of Light (summoned post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires a homing prismatic bolt that rains down piercing feathers.

weapons.name: Razorpine
weapons.source: Dropped by Everscream (Frost Moon)
weapons.why: Rapidly fires piercing pine-needle projectiles.

weapons.name: Resonance Scepter
weapons.source: Dropped by the Princess town NPC when killed (Princess requires Plantera-gated Cyborg and all other NPCs)
weapons.why: Fires a spread of rainbow music notes that pierce enemies.

weapons.name: Stellar Tune
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires homing star projectiles that pass through blocks and explode on impact.

weapons.name: Inferno Fork
weapons.source: Dropped by Diabolists (Hardmode Dungeon)
weapons.why: Fires a fireball that explodes into a lingering damaging blast.

weapons.name: Rainbow Gun
weapons.source: Found in Hallowed Chest in the Dungeon (opened with a Hallowed Key)
weapons.why: Launches a lasting rainbow that damages enemies along its arc.

weapons.name: Toxic Flask
weapons.source: Dropped by Dr. Man Fly (Solar Eclipse, post-mechanical boss)
weapons.why: Throws a flask that bursts into a lingering cloud inflicting Venom.

weapons.name: Clinger Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Corrupt Mimics (1/5) in the Hardmode Underground Corruption
weapons.why: Generates a lasting wall of Cursed Flame that damages and inflicts Cursed Inferno on enemies passing through.

weapons.name: Nimbus Rod
weapons.source: Dropped by Angry Nimbus (1/15) during rain in Hardmode
weapons.why: Spawns up to two lasting storm clouds that drop damaging rain projectiles below them.

weapons.name: Shadowbeam Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Necromancers (Hardmode Dungeon)
weapons.why: Fires a fast beam that ricochets off walls and pierces enemies.

weapons.name: Spectre Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Ragged Casters (Hardmode Dungeon)
weapons.why: Fires a homing spectral bolt that seeks enemies.

weapons.name: Tome of Infinite Wisdom
weapons.source: Dropped by Ogres during Tier 2 Old One's Army (requires one mechanical boss)
weapons.why: Fires bursts of pages, or with right-click a large piercing tornado.

weapons.name: Venom Staff
weapons.source: Crafted (Poison Staff + 14 Chlorophyte Bars @ Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
weapons.why: Upgraded Poison Staff whose fang inflicts the stronger Venom debuff.

weapons.name: Orange Zapinator
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires an erratic light beam with high random damage variance.

armor.name: Spectre Armor
armor.why: The damage-focused Spectre route is the default bossing answer here and the strongest overall mage upgrade before Golem.

armor.name: Spectre Hood Loadout
armor.why: Swapping to the hood is still worthwhile when you want the lifesteal safety valve for messy content.

accessories.name: Celestial Emblem
accessories.why: It is still the cleanest premium mage accessory because it boosts damage while supporting mana flow.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.why: Mage appreciates the broad stat lift once the core mana accessories are already in place.

accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.why: Auto-potions continue to remove a lot of execution friction during the phase's longer fights.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Debuff immunity remains a big comfort upgrade when so much of the content now involves status-heavy enemies.

accessories.name: Celestial Cuffs
accessories.source: Crafted from Magic Cuffs and Celestial Magnet.
accessories.why: Turns damage taken into mana and pulls in nearby mana stars.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.source: Crafted from Tabi, Black Belt, and Climbing Claws (Tinkerer).
accessories.why: Dash, a dodge chance, and wall-climb in a single slot.

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.why: It stays the best direct mage buff because the phase rewards squeezing extra value out of already-strong weapons.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: Sustain matters more than ever once the premium mage tools start draining mana aggressively.

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: It is still free magic power before every serious attempt, so it belongs in the routine.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: The extra forgiveness is welcome because post-Plantera content can punish mage instantly when positioning slips.

weapons.name: Deadly Sphere Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Deadly Spheres during a post-Plantera Solar Eclipse
weapons.why: Summons orbiting Deadly Sphere minions that dash at enemies.

weapons.name: Desert Tiger Staff
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Desert Chest, unlocked with a Desert Key after Plantera
weapons.why: Summons a single Desert Tiger minion that grows stronger with additional summons.

weapons.name: Terraprisma
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light if all damage is dealt during the day
weapons.why: Summons homing sword minions; Empress is fought via a post-Plantera Prismatic Lacewing.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.source: Dropped by Armored Bones enemies in the post-Plantera Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: Dropped by Hardmode Dungeon Armored Bones and gains crit chance with combos.

weapons.name: Pygmy Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Summons Pygmy minions that inflict Acid Venom.

weapons.name: Raven Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon
weapons.why: Summons Raven minions; obtained from the post-Plantera Pumpkin Moon event.

weapons.name: Staff of the Frost Hydra
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Ice Chest, opened with a Frozen Key (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Post-Plantera sentry summoning a Frost Hydra that fires piercing frost blasts.

weapons.name: Dark Harvest
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon
weapons.why: Pumpking drop whose swings can hit multiple times with a strong summon tag.

weapons.name: Vulgar Display of Flower
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Plantera drop that briefly boosts minion and whip damage after striking.

weapons.name: Queen Spider Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 24 Spider Fang at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil (Hardmode)
weapons.why: Early Hardmode sentry summoning a Spider Turret that lobs bouncing egg projectiles.

weapons.name: Ballista Cane
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep after defeating one mechanical boss (tier 2)
weapons.why: Tier 2 Tavernkeep upgrade of the ballista bolt sentry.

weapons.name: Firecracker
weapons.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
weapons.why: Wall of Flesh drop whose tag detonates for a large burst of minion damage.

weapons.name: Optic Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from Black Lens + 2 Lens + 12 Hallowed Bars + 20 Souls of Sight at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Summons Twins (Retanimini and Spazmamini) as one minion; needs Souls of Sight from The Twins.

weapons.name: Blade Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Slime
weapons.why: Summons Enchanted Dagger minions with low base damage that ignore 25 defense, scaling on flat/tag bonuses.

weapons.name: Spider Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 16 Spider Fangs at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: Summons Spider minions that inflict Acid Venom; Spider Fangs drop from Hardmode Black Recluses.

weapons.name: Durendal
weapons.source: Crafted (12 Hallowed Bar at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil)
weapons.why: Hallowed Bar whip with fast use time that boosts minion attack speed.

armor.name: Tiki Armor
armor.source: Bought from the Witch Doctor after Plantera
armor.why: This is the standard best pre-Golem summoner set because the extra minion capacity is too valuable to ignore.

armor.name: Spooky Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Spooky Wood from Pumpkin Moon
armor.why: If you are farming the event anyway, this is a strong damage-focused alternative to Tiki.

armor.name: Spider Armor
armor.why: It remains the reasonable fallback if your post-Plantera summon progression is still catching up.

accessories.name: Papyrus Scarab
accessories.why: This is the standout summoner accessory because it adds both slot value and direct minion scaling.

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.why: An extra minion remains one of the cleanest pure-value upgrades available to summoner.

accessories.name: Necromantic Scroll
accessories.source: Dropped by Mourning Wood during Pumpkin Moon
accessories.why: It is both a real summon upgrade and the natural step toward the Papyrus Scarab.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.why: Debuff immunity gives summoner a lot of breathing room in the phase's messier event content.

accessories.name: Celestial Stone
accessories.source: Crafted from Sun Stone and Moon Stone.
accessories.why: A well-rounded boost to damage, crit, regen, and speed.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.source: Crafted from Tabi, Black Belt, and Climbing Claws (Tinkerer).
accessories.why: Dash, a dodge chance, and wall-climb in a single slot.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.why: An extra minion is still the best single buff you can bring into a summoner build.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: It stacks cleanly with the potion and remains part of every real summoner pre-fight routine.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Summoner still needs all the baseline survivability help it can get.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: The damage reduction is especially welcome when a summoner gets clipped by dense event patterns.
